title: termal_list_sessions from a domain-bound session (Engram::Merger) refused with 409 "federation authority changed; refresh enrollment and retry"; session discovery blocked
outcome:
A domain-bound session can discover sessions with termal_list_sessions. If its federation authority is genuinely stale, the refusal names the actual stale binding and a recovery that the session itself, or its operator, can perform without a host restart.

Observed at 2026-11-08 00:23:34Z: Engram::Merger (Central session-11859, a domain session) called termal_list_sessions({}) and got `TermAl delegation API returned 409 Conflict: federation authority changed; refresh enrollment and retry`. Discovery was blocked; no fallback or retry was attempted.

Related: w-59e712e2dd9e (closed; landed in ba6c9846) made central-authority refusals name their specific cause, but only for local sends. The running Central host was still on the pre-ba6c build at the time: ba6c was installed about 00:1x and not yet restarted, so this response carried the old generic text. w-009fe89b37b8 concerns relay mailbox reads.
acceptance: The refusal path for termal_list_sessions from a domain-bound caller is identified from code and recorded, together with whether this occurrence is a correct refusal (genuinely stale domain authority) or a defect. The specific cause is observed on a build containing ba6c9846's diagnostics where possible.

If it is a defect, list_sessions succeeds for that caller, with a deterministic regression test. If the refusal is correct, the error names the stale binding and a recovery that works without a host restart, with a test. The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact committed input.

completion.summary: Directory diagnostic and no-restart recovery change landed in combo16 with reviewed source, deterministic author checks and exact-tree landing FULLs. Historical generic refusal cause remains honestly unclassified.
